slides.headline: 1) GET FIVE EXPERT OPINIONS IN ONE PROMPT
slides.body: A strategy consultant charges $300 to $500 an hour and gives you one perspective. This prompt gives you five expert lenses on the same decision, in one session, for free.

slides.headline: 2) WRITE 20 COPY VARIATIONS IN ONE PROMPT
slides.body: You burn 20 separate back-and-forths getting 20 options one at a time. This gets every variation in one response, each labeled by hook type so you know what to test.

slides.headline: 3) GET ALL PROJECT DELIVERABLES IN ONE SESSION
slides.body: Most business owners spread one project across four or five sessions, one deliverable each time. This prompt collapses all five into a single response.

slides.headline: 4) MAKE CLAUDE DESTROY ITS OWN ADVICE
slides.body:
Claude's first answer is its polite answer.

This follow-up prompt forces it to name the three most specific reasons you should not follow it.

slides.headline: 5) PICK UP MID-PROJECT WHEN YOUR LIMITS RESET
slides.body: Anthropic's paid plans have weekly usage limits that reset. When yours runs out mid-project, most people start from scratch, this handoff prompt means you never lose progress.

caption:
Swipe. These 5 Claude techniques fit a week of work into one session, and Anthropic confirmed hidden limits on paid plans this week. 💡

The Expert Panel gives you five expert opinions in one prompt for free, the Batch 20 writes every copy variation at once labeled by hook type, the Everything Stack generates all your project deliverables in a single session instead of five, the Contrarian Audit forces Claude to find the fatal flaw in its own advice before you act on it, and the Memory Handoff creates a document you paste into a fresh session when your usage limits reset so Claude picks up exactly where you stopped.

Anthropic's usage limits went viral this week as power users hit them mid-project. Smart ones treat every session like a sprint: all deliverables at once, all variations in one go, a handoff before it ends. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
